column1: # Nave's topics PROPOSED as contested (Christian traditions genuinely differ). Dave to confirm.
# Columns: exact Nave's topic name | what the disagreement is about

column2: Who should be baptized (believers only, or infants too), how (immersion, pouring, sprinkling) and what it does.
What the bread and cup are (memorial, spiritual presence, real presence) and who may take them.
Whether God chooses who will be saved unconditionally (Reformed) or on foreseen faith (Wesleyan/Arminian).
Whether a true believer can finally fall away ("once saved, always saved").
Same disagreement as Perseverance: can a genuine believer lose salvation?
Whether Christians can reach "entire sanctification" or Christian perfection in this life (Wesleyan view).
Whether sanctification is gradual only, or also includes a second definite work (Wesleyan and Holiness view).
Premillennial, postmillennial and amillennial readings of the thousand years.
Who or what the Antichrist is and when he appears; ties to end-times views.
Whether speaking in tongues continues today and whether it marks baptism in the Holy Spirit.
Whether the Sabbath command carries over to Sunday (the Lord's Day) and how strictly.
